paragraphs: According to [Berakhot 12b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.12b.14), Rabbi Abbahu bar Zutarti reported in the name of Rav Yehuda bar Zevida.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage explicitly gives the transmission chain, with Rabbi Abbahu ben Zutarti reporting in the name of Rabbi Yehuda bar Zevida. Hyman’s notice has Rav for Yehuda, and his heading has bar for Abbahu’s patronymic.
